cohort: 145 women admitted for induction of labor (IOL) after the 41st week of gestation, induced with a vaginal pessary releasing prostaglandins
finding: High Bishop score and multiparity were protective factors for vaginal delivery, while age >35 years and fetal birth weight >3500 g were risk factors for caesarean section in women undergoing IOL with prostaglandins after 41 weeks of gestation.
